## Release label

<!--
Maintainers: to release when this PR is merged to master, apply ONE label:
- `release:patch` - bug fixes and small improvements (2.0.0 → 2.0.1)
- `release:minor` - new features, nothing breaks (2.0.0 → 2.1.0)
- `release:major` - breaking changes (2.0.0 → 3.0.0)

No label: no new version. The bundles on the latest release are rebuilt from master.
Add a `## X.Y.Z` section to CHANGELOG.md in the same PR: it becomes the release notes.
See CONTRIBUTING.md.
-->
